lines.say: Nine seconds. That's how long your orders page takes to load, because to show ten orders, your app asks the database for a million.
lines.show: [Nine seconds.] That's how long your orders page takes to load, because to show *ten orders,* your app asks the database for [a million.]

lines.say: Your database keeps orders like a giant spreadsheet: one row per order, from every user, with a column for each detail. And your app's request says: send me all of it.
lines.show: Your database keeps orders like a giant *spreadsheet:* one row per order, from every user, with a column for each detail. And your app's request says: [send me all of it.]

lines.say: A million rows, every column, travel across to your app. Your code keeps your ten newest, and throws the rest away.
lines.show: A million rows, every column, travel across to your app. Your code keeps your *ten newest,* and [throws the rest away.]

lines.say: That request is a query. A better one asks for exactly what the page shows: your ten newest orders, and only the details on screen.
lines.show: That request is a *query.* A better one asks for *exactly* what the page shows: your ten newest orders, and only the details on screen.

lines.say: Like a shopping list: you order milk and eggs, not the whole shop at your door.
lines.show: Like a shopping list: you order *milk and eggs,* not the [whole shop] at your door.

lines.say: That's one piece of query optimization: ten rows come back, instead of a million. Far less to send, far less to process.
lines.show: That's one piece of *query optimization:* ten rows come back, instead of a million. *Far less* to send, far less to process.

lines.say: Want to see how the database finds those rows? Put EXPLAIN in front of the query. If it reads the whole table to find a few rows, an index can help.
lines.show: Want to see how the database finds those rows? Put *EXPLAIN* in front of the query. If it reads the [whole table] to find a few rows, an *index* can help.

lines.say: If AI writes your code, follow for the system design it leaves out.
lines.show: If AI writes your code, *follow* for the system design it leaves out.
